notes: Your bot can now read X (Twitter): paste any post link for the exact text, author, date and likes — or ask what an account has been posting lately, newest first. No login and no API key needed; every result shows its real date.
notes_zh: 你的机器人现在可以阅读 X（推特）：粘贴任意帖子链接即可获得原文、作者、日期和点赞数；也可以询问某个账号最近发布了什么，按最新排列。无需登录，无需 API 密钥，每条结果都标注真实日期。

v1.1.2.en: Your bot now reads X (Twitter) word for word: paste any post link for the exact text, author, date and likes — or ask what an account has been posting lately, read straight from X, newest first. No login, no API key; every result carries its real date, and an account that isn't archived is reported honestly.
v1.1.2.zh: 你的机器人现在能逐字阅读 X（推特）：粘贴任意帖子链接即可获得原文、作者、日期和点赞数；也可以询问某个账号最近发布了什么——直接从 X 读取，最新在前。无需登录，无需 API 密钥；每条结果都标注真实日期，未被收录的账号会如实说明。

v1.1.1.en: Run any schedule on demand: /runreminder <number> (or "run a sample now" in chat) executes the real job immediately — the real price, the real report — and your schedule stays untouched. Confirmations now always confirm the schedule first.
v1.1.1.zh: 随时运行任何计划：/runreminder <序号>（或在聊天里说“先跑一个看看”）会立即执行真正的任务——真实价格、真实报告——并且不会影响你的计划安排。确认消息现在总会先确认已设置的计划。
